message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Project Organization & Stability Update
This major update introduces an intelligent Project Organizer engine, Composition Board layouts, non-destructive Text Re-Align tools, and a massive pass of critical bug fixes across core modules.

♦️ Smart Project Organizer
* Analyze-First Workflow: Scans project statistics (comps, precomps, footage, audio, solids, missing/unused files) before organizing.
* Numbered Folder Architecture: Automated structure sorting (01_MAIN COMPS, 02_PRECOMPS, 03_VIDEO, 04_IMAGES, 05_AUDIO, 06_SOLIDS, 07_DATA, 08_OTHER, 99_UNUSED).
* Safe Non-Destructive Operations: Replaced old organizer with a preview-first workflow that never deletes layers or comps, skipping complex 3D/animated transforms safely.

♦️ Composition Board Engine
* Precomp Grid Arranger: Automatically tiles selected precomps into structured board columns with custom gutters and comp name labels.
* One-Click Snapshot Restore: Saves exact transform states to revert arranged layers back to original positions instantly.

♦️ Advanced Text Re-Align Tools
* Precision Alignment: Added Left, Center, Right, and Comp-Centering alignment modes preserving anchor points or visual bounds.
* Multi-Layer & Dynamic Context: Automatically exposes controls on text selection while skipping keyframed or expression-driven transform channels.
* Typing Interruption Fix: Eliminates constant layer polling to allow smooth, uninterrupted text editing.

♦️ Core Bug Fixes & Stability
* Single-Click Ejection: Fixed Eject button requiring double clicks.
* Pre-Comp Saver Fixes: Corrected layer displacement and fixed UI overlap on the preset delete button.
* Template Engine Safety: Resolved template displacement, eliminated 'Undo group mismatch' warnings, and fixed full-template movement crash vectors.
* Graph Editor Scaling: Made Graph Editor UI responsive for lower-resolution displays.
* Effect Trimming & Polish: Fixed Orb Generator mesh gaps, bounded Shake Effect duration strictly to selection, and restored Grid Layer generation.
